actions.name: Use
actions.area: allies within a 30-ft.-radius burst centered on you

description.summary: The caster emulates the glittering enhancement of Carbuncle
description.value: The caster emulates the glittering enhancement of Carbuncle. Allies within 30 ft. roll a d6. They get a +5 bonus to a random attribute based on the d6 result. 1 is Strength, 2 is Dexterity, 3 is Constitution, 4 is Intelligence, 5 is Wisdom, and 6 is Charisma. The bonus decreases by 1 every round at the beginning of the affected ally’s turn. Learned From Carbuncle
